**Earflow — known safe patterns (do not flag as vulnerabilities):**
- Cosmetic UI preferences in localStorage via `frontend/src/utils/*` + `useSyncExternalStore` (mini bar variant, play style) — not auth tokens
- `.env.example` containing placeholder names without real secret values
- Test/e2e fixtures with fake credentials clearly scoped to CI (`auth-e2e`, playwright mocks)
- Documentation-only changes under `docs/`, `reports/`, `universal_project_agent_pack/`, `.cursor/rules/`
- Parameterized SQL with `$1`/`?` placeholders even when query string is built from constants
- Rate limiting noted as future hardening on internal-only service routes without public exposure
- `passWithNoTests` or skipped tests in CI config without security impact

**Still report even if common elsewhere:**
- Real secrets in diff (API keys, JWT secrets, private keys)
- CSRF disabled or bypassed on cookie-authenticated mutating routes
- Auth checks removed from protected endpoints
- SQL concatenation with unsanitized user input
- JWT/session material in localStorage
